review_scope: Manual inspection of frames 1, 9, and 17 from base, step-10, and step-20 using identical inference settings.

observations.base: Generated a colorful cylindrical object rather than a recognizable architectural building.
observations.step-10: Remained visually close to the base result and did not show a clear architectural-domain change.
observations.step-20: Generated a centered white-background high-rise architectural form, showing that the LoRA load and building-domain signal are effective.
observations.temporal_motion: The inspected first, middle, and last frames changed very little. Smooth orbiting or rotation has not been learned in this 20-step smoke run.

conclusion: The smoke test validates the training, checkpoint loading, and domain-adaptation pipeline. It does not establish generalization, multi-view consistency, or completion ability.
decision: Proceed to a fixed train/validation/test split and a 200-video pilot before any full-dataset run.
